facts.fact: ITWeb Africa says Kenya and the World Bank finished the first phase of 730 km of fibre from Eldoret to Nadapal-Nakodok on the South Sudan border under EARTTDFP, and the 740 km Horn of Africa Gateway link to Ethiopia and Somalia is now being implemented.
